name: Burn size in palms
unit: count of palms (each about 1% of body surface)
device: None (count with the patient's own palm)
why_it_matters: Burn size guides care. A burn about the size of the palm or larger needs the flight surgeon (MedlinePlus Burns, When to Contact a Medical Professional).
